theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.projection_creates_regime_eq
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {C D : Type} (π : C → D) (ι : D → C) (R : Regime) (x : C) (h_contract : ∃ c : RegimeContract R C x ((ι ∘ π) x), True) : x ≡[R] ((ι ∘ π) x)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_eq_not_implies_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (R : Regime) (a b : α) (h_neq : a ≠ b) : (a ≡[R] b) → ¬(a = b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_eq_refl

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_eq_symm
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (R : Regime) (a b : α) : (a ≡[R] b) → (b ≡[R] a)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_eq_trans_same
